# Saint Cleophas Outreach Ministry

> An independent sacramental parish rooted in the Anglican liturgical tradition, serving Martinsville and Collinsville, Virginia. Part of the independent sacramental movement, the parish worships using the 1979 Book of Common Prayer, the Revised Common Lectionary, and the Hymnal 1982. Dedicated to recognizing the face of Christ in marginalized people. Tagline: "Recognizing Christ in the Stranger." Pastor: The Very Rev. Fr. Mychal Joseph Gallop.

## Worship

- [Mass Times & Schedule](https://stcleophasministry.com/mass-times.html): Full liturgical schedule. Sunday Mass 3:00 PM at Smith Memorial United Methodist Church Chapel, 2703 Daniels Creek Rd, Collinsville VA 24078 (in person and live-streamed on Facebook). Wednesday Mass 12:00 PM at First Baptist Church Chapel, 23 Starling Ave, Martinsville VA 24112. Bible Study Wednesdays 1:00 PM. Confession 2:30 PM before Sunday Mass; also available during office hours. Anointing of the Sick available during office hours and by appointment for the homebound or hospitalized.
- [News & Announcements](https://stcleophasministry.com/news.html): Parish announcements and news.

## About

- [Home](https://stcleophasministry.com/index.html): Welcome, mission overview, and the story of Saint Cleophas and the Road to Emmaus (Luke 24:13–35).
- [Our Church](https://stcleophasministry.com/church.html): Parish identity. Saint Cleophas is an independent sacramental parish rooted in the Anglican liturgical tradition, part of the independent sacramental movement. Explains the parish's identity, its liturgical tradition, and its mission of radical welcome.
- [Ministries & Outreach](https://stcleophasministry.com/ministries.html): Worship, pastoral care, Bible study, and community-based outreach, with particular attention to people experiencing housing insecurity, poverty, or social isolation. Includes the Pastoral Team: The Very Rev. Fr. Mychal Joseph Gallop (Pastor), Kato Padgett (Lay Minister), and John Fulcher (Music Minister).
- [Partners & Collaborators](https://stcleophasministry.com/partners.html): Ecumenical partners. Hosting partners: Smith Memorial United Methodist Church (Collinsville) and First Baptist Church (Martinsville). Community partners: Forest Park Country Club — Clubhouse Grill, First United Methodist Church (Uptown Ministry Center), Holy Trinity Lutheran Church, and Chatham Heights Baptist Church.
